fullCurrentGoal.title: Molekülorbital-Modelle anwenden
fullCurrentGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann einfache MO-Diagramme (z. B. O2, N2) interpretieren und Bindungsordnung ableiten.
fullCurrentGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can interpret simple MO diagrams (e.g. O2, N2) and derive bond order.

resourceLinks.title: Visualisierung: Molekülorbital-Modelle anwenden
resourceLinks.altText: Didaktische Visualisierung zum Lernziel "Molekülorbital-Modelle anwenden". Die lernende Person kann einfache MO-Diagramme (z. B. O2, N2) interpretieren und Bindungsordnung ableiten.

fullRetainedSourceOperatorCluster.title: Wellenfunktionen und MO-Energieniveauschemata verknüpfen
fullRetainedSourceOperatorCluster.titleEn: Connect wave functions and molecular-orbital energy schemes
fullRetainedSourceOperatorCluster.description: Die lernende Person kann zweidimensionale Darstellungen von Wellenfunktionen bei Wasserstoff-Atomen und beim Wasserstoff-Molekül mit räumlichen Wahrscheinlichkeitsdichten verknüpfen und aus Energieniveauschemata die Existenz einfacher zweiatomiger Moleküle oder Molekül-Ionen der zweiten Periode ableiten.
fullRetainedSourceOperatorCluster.descriptionEn: The learner can connect two-dimensional representations of wave functions in hydrogen atoms and hydrogen molecules with spatial probability densities and infer the existence of simple diatomic molecules or molecular ions of the second period from energy-level schemes.

2026-10-13 bounded author candidate: the current official C12 gA/eA Lernbereich 4 connects diatomic existence to MO energy schemas and explicitly treats bonding/antibonding MOs, sigma/pi energy schemas and N2/O2 binding relationships. The existing full-source cluster partner is preserved. The new atomic component interprets these same schemes and quantifies net bonding as bond order; this is a didactic operationalization, not a literal source quotation or an independent approval. No claim is made for RP or other jurisdictions.

exactWholeCellCAS.derivedOperationalization: Balance bonding and antibonding orbital occupancy in the explicitly taught MO schemes to quantify the same binding relationships and support the prescribed existence inference. No new molecular family, model, or comparative-stability topic is introduced.
exactWholeCellCAS.courseScope: Current official native C12 gA and eA LB4; technical SkillPilot LK tag remains unchanged. Adding this source component must be independently checked against both source occurrences and actual projection semantics. No automatic entitlement for any other jurisdiction.
